# `Isinglandr`: Landscape Construction and Simulation for Ising Networks

A toolbox for constructing potential landscapes for Ising networks. The
parameters of the networks can be directly supplied by users or
estimated by the `IsingFit` package by van Borkulo and Epskamp (2016)
<https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=IsingFit> from empirical data. The
Ising model’s Boltzmann distribution is preserved for the potential
landscape function. The landscape functions can be used for quantifying
and visualizing the stability of network states, as well as visualizing
the simulation process.

## Installation

You can install the development version of Isinglandr from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("Sciurus365/Isinglandr")
```

## Example

### Landscape construction

``` r

library(Isinglandr)
#> Registered S3 method overwritten by 'Isinglandr':
#>   method          from    
#>   print.landscape simlandr
#  A toy network and its landscape
Nvar <- 10
m <- rep(0, Nvar)
w <- matrix(0.1, Nvar, Nvar)
diag(w) <- 0

result1 <- make_2d_Isingland(m, w)
plot(result1)
```

![](reference/figures/README-example-1.png)

``` r


## What if the network becomes denser?
result2 <- make_2d_Isingland(m, 1.5 * w)
plot(result2)
```

![](reference/figures/README-example-2.png)

``` r


## What if the thresholds become lower?
result3 <- make_2d_Isingland(m - 0.5, w)
plot(result3)
```

![](reference/figures/README-example-3.png)

``` r


## Multiple networks together
result4 <- make_Ising_grid(
  all_thresholds(seq(-0.1, 0.1, 0.1), .f = `+`),
  whole_weiadj(seq(0.5, 1.5, 0.5)),
  m, w
) %>% make_2d_Isingland_matrix()
plot(result4)
#> Scale for x is already present.
#> Adding another scale for x, which will replace the existing scale.
```

![](reference/figures/README-example-4.png)

### Simulation on landscapes

``` r

set.seed(1614)
sim1 <- simulate_Isingland(result1, initial = 5)
plot(sim1)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-2-1.gif)

``` r


set.seed(1614)
sim4 <- simulate_Isingland(result4, initial = 5)
plot(sim4)
```

![](reference/figures/README-unnamed-chunk-2-2.gif)

## Shiny app

A shiny app is included in this package to show the landscape for the
Ising network of major depressive disorder. The network parameters can
be manipulated to see how they influence the landscape and the
simulation. Run
[`shiny_Isingland_MDD()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/shiny_Isingland_MDD.md)
to start it.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`MDDConnectivity`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/MDDNetwork.md)
  [`MDDThresholds`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/MDDNetwork.md)
  : Estimation data for the Ising network of major depressive disorder
- [`autolayer(`*`<stability_2d_Isingland>`*`)`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/autolayer.stability.md)
  [`autolayer(`*`<stability_2d_Isingland_matrix>`*`)`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/autolayer.stability.md)
  : Get ggplot2 layers of stability metrics to add to the landscape
  plots
- [`calculate_barrier(`*`<2d_Isingland>`*`)`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/calculate_barrier.Isingland.md)
  [`calculate_barrier(`*`<2d_Isingland_matrix>`*`)`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/calculate_barrier.Isingland.md)
  [`print(`*`<barrier_2d_Isingland>`*`)`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/calculate_barrier.Isingland.md)
  [`summary(`*`<barrier_2d_Isingland>`*`)`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/calculate_barrier.Isingland.md)
  [`summary(`*`<barrier_2d_Isingland_matrix>`*`)`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/calculate_barrier.Isingland.md)
  : Calculate energy barrier for Ising landscapes
- [`calculate_stability()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/calculate_stability.md)
  : Calculate the stability metrics for Ising landscapes
- [`calculate_stability_se()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/calculate_stability_se.md)
  [`print(`*`<stability_se>`*`)`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/calculate_stability_se.md)
  [`compare_stability()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/calculate_stability_se.md)
  : Calculate the standard error, confidence interval, and p-value for
  the stability metrics of an Ising landscape using bootstrapping
- [`chain_simulate_Isingland()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/chain_simulate_Isingland.md)
  [`make_Ising_chain()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/chain_simulate_Isingland.md)
  : Make Ising chains from (a series of) Ising grid(s) and perform a
  chain simulation.
- [`make_2d_Isingland()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/make_2d_Isingland.md)
  : Make a 2D landscape for an Ising network
- [`make_2d_Isingland_matrix()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/make_2d_Isingland_matrix.md)
  : Make a matrix of landscapes for multiple Ising networks
- [`make_3d_Isingland()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/make_3d_Isingland.md)
  : Make a 3D landscape for an Ising network
- [`single_threshold()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/make_Ising_grid-control-functions.md)
  [`single_wei()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/make_Ising_grid-control-functions.md)
  [`all_thresholds()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/make_Ising_grid-control-functions.md)
  [`whole_weiadj()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/make_Ising_grid-control-functions.md)
  [`beta_list()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/make_Ising_grid-control-functions.md)
  : Control Functions to Specify the Varying Parameters for an Ising
  Grid.
- [`make_Ising_grid()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/make_Ising_grid.md)
  : Make a Grid to Specify Multiple Ising Networks
- [`shiny_Isingland_MDD()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/shiny_Isingland_MDD.md)
  : A shiny app that shows the landscape for the Ising network of major
  depressive disorder
- [`simulate_Isingland()`](https://sciurus365.github.io/Isinglandr/reference/simulate_Isingland.md)
  : Simulate a 2D Ising landscape
